papers.title: Exact Sampling from Determinantal Point Processes
papers.abstract: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) are an important concept in random matrix theory and combinatorics. They have also recently attracted interest in the study of numerical methods for machine learning, as they offer an elegant "missing link" between independent Monte Carlo sampling and deterministic evaluation on regular grids, applicable to a general set of spaces. This is helpful whenever an algorithm explores to reduce uncertainty, such as in active learning, Bayesian optimization, reinforcement learning, and marginalization in graphical models. To draw samples from a DPP in practice, existing literature focuses on approximate schemes of low cost, or comparably inefficient exact algorithms like rejection sampling. We point out that, for many settings of relevance to machine learning, it is also possible to draw exact samples from DPPs on continuous domains. We start from an intuitive example on the real line, which is then generalized to multivariate real vector spaces. We also compare to previously studied approximations, showing that exact sampling, despite higher cost, can be preferable where precision is needed.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于从行列式点过程中精确采样的数学方法，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, does not handle constraints, does not provide uncertainty quantification for physical models, and is not demonstrated on implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决行列式点过程精确采样在机器学习中的可行性与实用性。
summary_zh.method: 提出连续域上行列式点过程的精确采样算法。
summary_zh.result: 精确采样相比近似方法在精度要求高时更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维和多维连续空间的数值示例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable exact sampling from determinantal point processes on continuous domains, which enhances precision in machine learning tasks like Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: An exact sampling algorithm for determinantal point processes is derived, starting from an intuitive one-dimensional example and generalized to multivariate real vector spaces.
summary_en.result: Exact sampling is shown to be feasible and preferable over approximate methods when high precision is required.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical examples on synthetic continuous domains, comparing with approximate sampling techniques.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of Zr-based bulk metallic glasses: Processing, microstructure and mechanical properties
papers.first_author_affiliation: University of Leuven (KU Leuven), Department of Mechanical Engineering, 3001 Leuven, Belgium

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaopeng Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Leuven (KU Leuven), Department of Mechanical Engineering, 3001 Leuven, Belgium

corresponding_authors.name: T.B. Sercombe
corresponding_authors.affiliation: The University of Western Australia, School of Mechanical and Chemical Engineering, Perth, WA 6009, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选区激光熔化Zr基非晶合金的工艺与力学性能，但未涉及医用植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding or stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化Zr基非晶合金的工艺与性能。
summary_zh.method: 改变激光参数制备非晶合金并测试显微组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 获得完全非晶结构，压缩强度达1.8 GPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、DSC和压缩试验验证非晶结构与力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the processing window and resulting microstructure of Zr-based bulk metallic glasses fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of laser parameters to achieve fully amorphous structure followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Fully amorphous samples with high compressive strength up to 1.8 GPa were obtained.
summary_en.validation: XRD, DSC, and compression testing confirmed amorphous structure and mechanical properties.
